Name: dagbandabo_fong
CharacterSummary: Commercial & civic heart anchored by the Naa Gbewaa Interchange, Central Market, Central Mosque, and Dakpema Palace.

Name: aboabo
CharacterSummary: Vibrant inner-city market quarter famed for Aboabo Market, grain depots, fabric stalls, and close-knit compound streets.

Name: tishigu
CharacterSummary: Historic residential-commercial community between Central Market, Jubilee Park, and Kalpohin.

Name: kalpohin
CharacterSummary: Mixed modern estate and established residential district hosting Kalpohin SHS and self-contained walled homes.

Name: gumani
CharacterSummary: Fast-growing residential expansion zone on Tamale's northeastern edge with active concrete construction.

Name: jakarayili
CharacterSummary: Lively eastern residential-commercial pocket flanking Jubilee Park and Tamale High Street.

Name: kukuo
CharacterSummary: Well-known eastern suburb famed for Kukuo Market and traditional earthen pottery craftsmanship.

Name: vittin
CharacterSummary: Eastern ring-road community connecting Tamale toward Yendi Road and contemporary art spaces (SCCA / Red Clay).

Name: dabokpaa
CharacterSummary: Southeastern community near Tamale Teaching Hospital and Technical University corridors.

Name: lamashegu
CharacterSummary: Major commercial, market, and transport-repair hub south of Central Tamale along Salaga Road.

Name: kakpagyili
CharacterSummary: Southern neighbourhood anchored by Kakpagyili Market, family compounds, and local mosques.

Name: nyohini
CharacterSummary: Western neighbourhood stretching along Sagnarigu Road with dense residential compounds and stadium approaches.

Name: sagnarigu
CharacterSummary: Sister municipal centre hosting Aliu Mahama Sports Stadium, Sagnarigu Palace avenues, and residential estates.

Name: choggu
CharacterSummary: Established northern residential district with leafy neem streets, churches, mosques, and family compounds.

Name: gumbihini
CharacterSummary: Inner-northern neighbourhood known for its waterworks heritage, market gardens, and residential lanes.

Name: kanvilli
CharacterSummary: Northern highway suburb along N10 leading toward Tamale International Airport.

Name: dungu
CharacterSummary: Southwestern academic & residential community home to the University for Development Studies (UDS) Tamale campus corridor.
